verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a Privacy Mode under which code is "never used for training by Cursor or other AI model providers". It is on by default for Enterprise teams. Cloud Agents are the only feature that stores code, and only temporarily in encrypted form while the agent runs; sub-processors are published. The BYO-keys doc adds a caveat: Zero Data Retention does not apply when you use your own API keys. Missing for 10: how individual (non-Enterprise) users enable Privacy Mode, whether the guarantee covers non-code data such as prompts and telemetry, and independent verification of the no-training claim.
